items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I remember, you know, seeing your name in connection with Rita Demetri. [INTERVIEWEE] Right.

ctx.x: No. Put it this way. They paid for my lessons and saw that I practiced. But their participation was nil.

Well, we've talked about your involvement with shows and accompanying people, et cetera, et cetera, which more or less brings us up to the, you know, the present time. I know I had lost, kind of lost contact with you because I think you were doing so many of these, you know, backing jobs for singers and all that, and I remember, you know, seeing your name in connection with Rita Demetri.
